comparisons.peer_topic: Intangible assets capitalization and amortization history
comparisons.peer_summary: The company capitalized $84 million, $87 million, and $158 million for product and process technology in 2024, 2023, and 2022, respectively, with weighted-average useful lives ranging from 9 to 10 years. Amortization expense for these assets was $82 million, $86 million, and $85 million for the same respective years.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and Micron disclose the capitalization and amortization of licensed technology and product/process technology as intangible assets. Intel capitalized $562 million in 2024 for licensed technology arrangements subject to amortization, whereas Micron capitalized $84 million for product and process technology with a 10-year weighted-average useful life in the same year. While Intel's disclosure focuses on the total cost of new or renewed arrangements, Micron provides specific useful life estimates for its capitalized technology.

sentences.text: During 2024 and 2023, we entered into and/or renewed several licensed technology arrangements totaling $562 million and $309 million respectively, which are subject to amortization.

In 2024, 2023, and 2022, we capitalized $84 million, $87 million, and $158 million, respectively, for product and process technology with weighted-average useful lives of 10 years, 9 years, and 9 years, respectively.
